scoringPolicy: No aggregate level is claimed. This is an evidence/gap projection, not a formal NDSA certification or score.

proven: Two byte-identical accepted AIP copies in distinct Archivematica Storage Service locations.
AIP master and replica have identical SHA-256.
gap: Both copies share the same host/WSL failure domain.
No independent offsite/site failure-domain copy is proven.

proven: Frozen 49-file source manifest verifies 49/49 inside retrieved AIP.
Scheduled Artefactual Fixity client exists and a forced scan passed all six AIPs.
gap: Fixity availability depends on Storage Service liveness; a stopped provider caused a scheduled scan failure earlier the same day.

proven: Storage Service locations and provider API own persistence rather than ad-hoc file writes.
Fixity credentials are stored in a root-owned environment file.
gap: A complete preservation-role/access-control audit was not performed in this R1.

proven: E-ARK SIP/CSIP package was created and validated.
Source identity, hashes, contracts, quality, lineage and revision evidence are included.
gap: Dataset rights/retention metadata remains incomplete upstream and is not solved by preservation packaging.

proven: Raw CSV, derived Parquet, runtime acquisition receipts and runtime OpenLineage events are all represented in the accepted AIP.
Hidden .gitignore files survived only after using the validated zipped-bag intake path.
gap: The assessment covers the selected data-lifecycle pilot corpus, not every Research/Finance/Distribution dataset.
NDSA 2.1 adds environmental-sustainability guidance; energy/resource lifecycle metrics were not assessed here.
